messages:
ryan_sales: Partner NexusCorp wants a blended private offer: combine a 12mo commit on Hosted + appliance vouchers. They asked for a 18% list discount + $40k appliance credit. Thoughts?

emma_partnerships: main risk is SKU mismatch between our marketplace listing and the appliance voucher SKU. NexusCorp invoices against their appliance SKU. Need mapping table. @marta_ops any constraints on redeemable voucher flow?

marta_ops: voucher flow ok but ops needs explicit billing SKU mapping and a weekly reconciliation file. minimum commit should cover voucher exposure; suggest $125k min. also onboarding support is 2 weeks standard, can extend to 6 weeks if we include an onboarding credit.

natalie_finance: call out: blended deals complicate revenue recognition. If voucher is redeemable against hardware, classify as separate deliverable. we'll need clear allocation % in the PO. can you provide a sample allocation?

ryan_sales: sample allocation idea: 85% service (Redwood Hosted) / 15% appliance credit. open to suggestions. client prefers single PO line if possible though.

marketplace-checker-bot: Marketplace policy check: private offers may not exceed 10% discount below public listing on AWS/GCP without marketplace approval. Also: some marketplaces forbid bundling non-software vouchers in the offer. See: https://marketplace.example.com/policy#bundling

tom_legal: flagged. If marketplace forbids bundling, we can still do a private offer for compute and a separate voucher agreement for appliances. Legal needs to add a cross-reference clause and warranty carve-outs. Also export controls: NexusCorp targets APAC region; check export-classification for the appliance firmware.

emma_partnerships: if we must split, we should design a coordinated launch cadence: private offer goes live same day as voucher activation window. That keeps partner perception tidy. Also add a renewal kicker: if they renew at >=90% of initial commit, apply a 5% extra discount on year2.

marta_ops: ops can support coordinated activation, but require SKU mapping csv with columns: partner_sku, redwood_sku, marketplace_sku, redeemable_flag. please use this header exactly.

natalie_finance: from modelling POV, run two scenarios: (A) bundled recognition with allocation (85/15), (B) split contract with voucher deferred revenue. show impact on ARR and gross margin at 12 and 24 months. need by Friday.

ryan_sales: i'll draft the proposal: option1 bundled (if marketplace allows) with 18% off public list and $40k voucher; option2 split if marketplace blocks bundling. target to send to NexusCorp by next Tue.

tom_legal: i'll prepare two clause sets: (1) bundled clause including marketplace parity fallback and voucher treatment; (2) split-agreement template referencing voucher redemption terms. will also add an SLA handoff and data residency addendum.

emma_partnerships: one more ask: partner wants co-announcement. marketing will need 6 weeks lead. note that we can't publish pricing specifics in co-announcement — just high-level customer quote.

marketplace-checker-bot: Uploaded voucher-mapping-template.csv and private-offer-policy-summary to /docs/marketplace/resources.

marta_ops: I'll prepare ops runbook snippet for voucher reconciliation and onboarding checklist by Monday. includes audit steps: ``reconcile_weekly(csv)`` and sample log output.

ryan_sales: great. action items: 1) me - draft PO variants, 2) natalie - finance models, 3) tom - clause sets, 4) marta - ops runbook + csv template, 5) emma - co-announcement timeline. aim to review Thursday.

emma_partnerships: thanks all. ping me if you hit a marketplace policy roadblock; i'll escalate to channels. :rocket:
